basic_info.description: This expansive 2BD/2BA wows with spectacular natural light, garage parking and an ideal Yerba Buena location where SoMa, Salesforce Park and FiDi meet. Inside, a gracious foyer with large closets and a Bosch washer-dryer leads to a spacious corner living room with lovely south-facing treetop views. The open kitchen impresses with custom cabinetry, granite counters, and Sub-Zero and Bosch appliances. Two oversized, carpeted bedrooms include an owner's suite with a large custom closet and en suite bathroom, plus a secondary bedroom and bath off the living room. Sold by the original pied--terre owner, this centrally located home is in pristine, move-in-ready condition. Enjoy 24-hour door-person service, key fob entry, three elevators, a handsome lobby, and a huge roof deck with panoramic views, barbecues, a fire-pit and seating. Enjoy remarkable dining, nightlife and shopping, including the new Dawn Club, Holbrook House, Starlite Room, Whole Foods, Target and more. Explore MoMA, Yerba Buena Gardens and local galleries, or head a few minutes southeast to take in a game or concert at Oracle Park or Chase Center. Nearby access to BART, Muni, tech shuttles, Caltrain, and the 80, 101 and 280 freeways put the rest of the city and Bay Area within easy reach.
